messages:
alex.k: Quick announcement — we are opening Dedicated 'Vela-140T' pools in europe-west3 (paris-2) starting 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC. Docs + perf guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/vela-paris
maya.r: Nice! Is this GA or preview? Any reservation requirements?
jordan_ops: Preview with reserved capacity opt-in. We'll enable a private rollout for existing Dedicated customers first, then open to self-serve reservations next week.
emily.sales: Heads-up to sales — please don't promise self-serve capacity until 2026-04-06. We'll share quota guidance in ~1h.
alex.k: Correct — preview -> reserved-only for 72 hours. Primary goals: soak traffic, validate multi-tenant isolation, and exercise burst policy.
ops-bot: @channel Scheduled provisioning window: 2026-04-02 18:00-20:00 UTC. Expected CA changes across eu-west3. No customer-facing downtime expected.
maya.r: Can you summarize hardware? folks keep asking about memory + perf.
alex.k: Vela-140T nodes: 140 TF infer class (codename), 128GB HBM, proprietary kernel bundles optimized for long-context caching. Early benchmarks: ~1.4x throughput vs our H100 pools at 2k seq for decoder-only models. Details in docs link.
jordan_ops: Allocation notes: customers with active Dedicated contracts will be able to request pool migration via the Console — there will be a single-mouse migration flow and optional canary shift.
devex: Migration UX question — do we surface recommended batching/kv cache toggles for customers migrating?
alex.k: Yes — the Console will show a "Vela tuning" checklist. Also posting a sample config block for infra teams:
```
# example autoscale policy for vela pools
pool: vela-paris-2
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 20
burst_slots: 4
priority: dedicated_reserved
```
maya.r: Any billing or unit changes? will per-token pricing differ?
emily.sales: Billing: same per-token model, but we have a new 'vela_premium' multiplier for committed capacity during preview (10% uplift) to recoup early infra costs. We'll revert to standard pricing post-preview.
sre-oncall: Ops note — we'll be enforcing a short-term cap per-tenant to prevent noisy-neighboring: default 4 concurrent replicas during preview. If a customer needs >4, submit a request to infra-ops with justification.
jordan_ops: Also flagging a minor policy change: burst borrowing across zones will be disabled for vela during initial 48h. Means no cross-zone fallback to keep isolation strict.
alex.k: Customer comms — we will send a product bulletin tomorrow 09:00 UTC with migration steps, FAQ, and SLA expectations. Please review the draft in #eng-runtime. @devex @emily.sales please ack.
devex: Acked, will batch docs + snippet + quickstart.
emily.sales: Ack, will hold off on outbound emails until bulletin goes live.
alex.k: If you see any issues during provisioning ping @sre-oncall. Thanks team :rocket:
